entities.summary: Štefan Marko Daxner, Hungarian: tóth-zabari Daxner István Márk was an ethnic Slovak lower nobleman, politician, lawyer, and poet in the Kingdom of Hungary. He was a member of what became known as the Ľudovít Štúr generation.
